facts.text: The package is a Python library for Newport Agilis piezo motion controllers (agUC2 and agUC8)
AGUC2 resets with 'MR' and then installs axis 1 and axis 2
AGUC2.move jogs axis 1 and waits until it is still, then jogs axis 2 and waits
goToZero reads both axis counters and jogs each axis by the negative of its counter
setZero resets the counter of both axes
A jog of n steps sends '<axis>PR<n>'
The stop command of an axis is '<axis>ST'
queryCounter sends '<axis>TP' and returns the accumulated steps since power-on or the last reset
The serial port is opened at 921600 baud with 8 data bits, no parity and one stop bit
The step amplitude of an axis is stated as 0 to 50
